description: For change order, this issue tracking log records added and deleted work, labor, material, equipment, subcontract, markup, exclusions, and time effect. Its supporting evidence includes field directive, estimate sheets, quotes, photos, time records, schedule fragment, and coordination notes.

title: Change Order Issue Tracking Log
use_case: Use the issue tracking log during trade change-order development and acceptance when the change order record must identify base work order, directive, affected task, location, pricing basis, schedule activity, and approval chain. Complete the applicable handoff for accepted price and days, revised work order, cost and schedule posting, field release, and distribution record.
